caption:
Figure 3: SeSAM framework for coarse sup ervision. First, pseudo-labels for training images are
generated by the teacher model. Next, these pseudo-labels are then refined following the key steps 1-3,
namely instance separation, point sampling and mask selection (see Section 3). To improve mask quality,
we augment coarse labels with high-confidence pseudo-labels before applying SAM (step 0). The resulting
refined labels, called SeSAM labels, are then used to train the student network.
body_evidence: Original arXiv v1 PDF page 4, Figure 3 caption and Section 3 method overview; independent data-region verification also performed.

role_and_message.evidence: The full teacher/student SeSAM training framework remains intact: weak/strong augmentation, teacher pseudo-labels, coarse supervision, refined SeSAM labels, student predictions and the loss are all retained.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All original photographic stacks, segmentation maps, refinement examples, instance masks, heatmap, point overlay and three SAM mask candidates are present; all 15 data-bearing regions were independently checked against the source.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Teacher, Student, EMA, pseudo-labels, coarse labels, SeSAM labels (s), predictions (p), loss(p,s), step numbers 0–3 and the repeat-for-all-instances statement match the original meanings.

connections_and_direction.evidence: The student-to-teacher dashed EMA direction is preserved. Refined labels and student predictions reach loss(p,s). The added step-0-to-instance-separation line agrees with the caption’s instruction to augment coarse labels before following steps 1–3; there is no step-0-to-step-3 bypass.

visual_encodings.evidence: The original segmentation colors, mask foregrounds, heatmap intensities, point placements and selected-mask green border are restored unchanged. Gray directed flow and the dashed EMA/expansion conventions remain distinct.

examples_and_data.evidence: All 15 registered data regions are identical 1:1 source copies: same dimensions, decoded RGB pixels and pixel SHA-256 values. This independently includes both photo stacks and every mask/map/point/heatmap region.

unsupported_additions.evidence: No new data result is introduced. The explicit step-0-to-step-1 connection is supported by the original caption, and “Selected mask” names the existing green-bordered selected candidate.

complete_visible_content.evidence: Every required original label, arrow endpoint and data tile is visible. Tiny faint gray residual ticks below the high-confidence tile do not form a label, alter data, or obscure the intact caption below that tile.

remaining_limitations: A few faint gray residual ticks under the high-confidence tile remain as a minor nonsemantic visual artifact; they do not alter the restored data or text. Fidelity does not imply improved aesthetic ratings. Scientific correctness beyond the supplied source is not independently verified.
